pairs.definition: Accounts receivable refers to the amounts owed to a company by its customers for goods sold or services rendered in the normal course of business. It is typically classified as a current asset and represents the amount customers owe the company due to credit transactions.
notes: Accounts Receivable is ambiguous here: the 2019 table lists both Trade receivables ($176.4 million) and Trade receivables, net ($175.1 million), so the requested gross or net measure is not specified.
